title: Use bounded operator variance and one terminal fine estimate
statement: For the actual Bernoulli record Y=y||Cz||^2 T(z), the received operator variance/range bounds support bounded matrix Bernstein after rational preconditioning. Constant-accuracy envelope stages plus one terminal fine estimate yield O_tilde(m^3/(gamma epsilon)); the epsilon>=gamma regime uses a direct additive estimate.

requires: Known dimension-m real state-preparation family and frozen actual receiver
Ordinary Bernoulli effect0<=A<=I, finite sampler and trusted paid controls
provides: A finite relative selector optimization without an exponential action grid
assumptions: No matrix-query oracle or raw-estimator heavy-tail assumption
No fitted eigenvalue determines free accuracy
Final state compilation is gap-free and paid
costs: O_tilde(m^3/(gamma epsilon)) source cap plus all m-anchor, global test, memory and O(m) synthesis costs
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: Using gamma precision at every floor stage retains an avoidable gamma^-2 cost.
